title: notholaena aurea
intro: Notholaena aurea, commonly known as the Golden Club Fern, is a species of fern native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Notholaena aurea include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, and its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is necessary to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
